subject.title: fix(groq): keep default Llama agent turns within TPM limit

question: Should Groq's TPM failure be handled by this exact provider/model/error-scoped retry, or should OpenClaw instead change implicit output reservations across OpenAI-compatible transports through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/104916?
rationale: Both approaches solve the same failure but establish different long-term provider and transport semantics; code review can identify defects, but it cannot safely choose that ownership boundary without maintainer intent.

options.title: Land the scoped Groq recovery
options.body: Fix all explicit-budget aliases in this PR, retain its live-proven narrow behavior, and close the broader competing PR.

options.title: Adopt the transport-wide change
options.body: Prefer https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/104916 after obtaining equivalent real-provider and cross-provider compatibility proof, then close this PR.

options.title: Pause both implementations
options.body: Define the intended relationship between model capability and default output reservation before accepting either recovery policy.

recommendation.title: Land the scoped Groq recovery
recommendation.body: Fix all explicit-budget aliases in this PR, retain its live-proven narrow behavior, and close the broader competing PR.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision primarily concerns agent runtime and provider-routing ownership, which repository ownership information associates with Vincent.
